panels.description: Number of requests grouped by HTTP Status Code

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toString(statusCode) as HTTP_Status_Code, $__timeInterval($timestamp) as time, ${cnt_all_var} as http
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(${timestamp})
AND $__adHocFilter() 
GROUP BY HTTP_Status_Code, time 
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Hits per status code; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Hits per Status Code

panels.description: Percentage share of each HTTP status code

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ${cnt_all_var} as count, toString(statusCode) as HTTP_Status_Code
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(${timestamp})
AND $__adHocFilter() 
GROUP BY HTTP_Status_Code 
ORDER BY count DESC
LIMIT 100
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=HTTP Status Code Distribution; du=${__user.login}'

targets.rawSql:
SELECT country, ${uniq_session_var}, ${cnt_all_var} as "Edge Hit", ${pct_offLoadHit_var} as "Offload Hit", ${sum_totalBytes_var} as "Total Bytes", ${pct_offLoadBytes_var} as "Offload Bytes", ${pct_errorRate_var} as "Error Rate"
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(${timestamp})
AND $__adHocFilter() 
GROUP BY country 
ORDER BY "Edge Hit" DESC
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Summary Table per Country; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT ${cnt_all_var} as "Edge Hit", ${pct_offLoadHit_var} as "Offload Hit", ${sum_totalBytes_var} as "Total Bytes", ${pct_offLoadBytes_var} as "Offload Bytes", ${pct_errorRate_var} as "Error Rate", ${uniq_session_var}, country
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(${timestamp})
AND $__adHocFilter() 
GROUP BY country 
ORDER BY "Edge Hit" DESC
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Summary Table per Country; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT cp as "CP Code", ${uniq_session_var}, ${cnt_all_var} as "Edge Hit", ${pct_offLoadHit_var} as "Offload Hit", ${sum_totalBytes_var} as "Total Bytes", ${pct_offLoadBytes_var} as "Offload Bytes", ${pct_errorRate_var} as "Error Rate"
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(${timestamp})
AND $__adHocFilter() 
GROUP BY cp 
ORDER BY "Edge Hit" DESC
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Summary Table per CPCode; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT rspContentType as item, ${cnt_all_var} as count
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(${timestamp})
AND $__adHocFilter() 
GROUP BY item 
ORDER BY count DESC
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Request Per Content Type; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT ${cnt_all_var} as count, UA, REPLACE(UA, ',', '__gfc__') AS escaped_UA
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(${timestamp})
AND $__adHocFilter() 
AND UA NOT IN '~~~SAMPLED_OUT~~~'
GROUP BY UA
ORDER BY count DESC
LIMIT 50
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Top 50 User Agent; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT ${cnt_all_var} as count, reqPath as RequestPath
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(${timestamp})
AND $__adHocFilter() 
AND RequestPath NOT IN '~~~SAMPLED_OUT~~~'
GROUP BY RequestPath
ORDER BY count DESC
LIMIT 50
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Top 50 Request Path; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT ${cnt_all_var} as count, cliIP as ClientIP
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(${timestamp})
 AND $__adHocFilter() 
 AND ClientIP NOT IN '~~~SAMPLED_OUT~~~'
GROUP BY ClientIP
ORDER BY count DESC
LIMIT 50
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Top 50 Client IP; du=${__user.login}'

WHEN ${duration} < 6 THEN '${ds2}'
WHEN ${duration} >= 6 AND ${duration} < 72 THEN '${summary_hour}'
WHEN ${duration} >= 72 THEN '${summary_day}'
END
